messages:
anna-ux: noticed a weird blip on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate at 09:22 PST — p50 steady, p95/p99 jumped. screenshot: https://redwood.internal/snap/latency-blip :thinking:
mike-platform: which chart? endpoint or region rollup?
anna-ux: endpoint -> /v1/generate. p95 and p99 only, lasted ~3m.
sam-telemetry: pulled raw minute buckets. sample_count collapses right before the spike. could be rate-limiter reroute.
sam-telemetry: ```json
{"t":"2023-08-25T09:21:00Z","samples":420,"p95":110}
{"t":"2023-08-25T09:22:00Z","samples":8,"p95":870}
{"t":"2023-08-25T09:23:00Z","samples":2,"p95":1500}
```
dez-sre: our rate-limiter logs show ~40% reroute to fallback pool at 09:21:58. fallback model latency distribution has a heavier tail.
lina-eng: important: console merges 60s rollups and tdigest merges across shards. when a window has very few samples, merging can amplify high quantiles if weight shifts mid-window.
mike-platform: so root cause is twofold: low sample-count instability + sudden routing weight shift mixing distributions. result: p95 spike.
anna-ux: UX fix idea: show a low-sample badge when sample_count < 10 and tooltip "percentiles unreliable". backend: mark sparse buckets and avoid naive tdigest merges.
sam-telemetry: rollout plan suggestion:
- pipeline: if sample_count < 5 emit a sparse_bucket marker and skip merging tdigest for that bucket.
- console: surface sample_count and low-sample badge; allow query param min_sample_count.
- routing: tag metrics when route-weight changed so dashboard can split by route.
lina-eng: hotfix: add `min_sample_count` param to dashboard queries, e.g. agg.window:60s, query.params:{min_sample_count:5,propagate_empty:true}.
mike-platform: long-term: store per-route tdigest so dashboards can show layered percentiles (global vs route-specific) and make shifts obvious.
dez-sre: I'll attempt a repro: synthetic traffic with a 40% sudden reroute to fallback for 2 minutes and capture dashboard.
anna-ux: if repro works, open RFC for pipeline change + console UX.
deploy-bot: canary: telemetry-pipeline v2.1 -> group=metrics-canary scheduled 2023-08-25T15:30:00Z.
sam-telemetry: caveat: downstream consumers expect tdigest continuity for alerts. when skipping merges we should emit a synthetic sparse datapoint with alert_exclude flag so alerts can opt out.
anna-ux: agree. add alert-exclude flag on sparse datapoints.
mike-platform: action items: 1) dez -> run repro; 2) sam -> prototype min_sample_count + sparse marker; 3) lina -> console badge & tooltip; 4) anna -> docs + update alerts to ignore sparse.
anna-ux: pinging @sam-telemetry @lina-eng @mike-platform — who owns the RFC? :thumbsup:
mike-platform: I'll own RFC and API change.
sam-telemetry: pipeline change owner.
lina-eng: console UX owner.
dez-sre: repro running now, will post results.
anna-ux: aiming for canary next week if repro clean. (reaction: :eyes:)
